caption: The drawing depicts a dog, specifically a greyhound, standing in profile facing to the right. The dog is colored in varying shades of gray and black, suggesting a smooth, short-haired coat. It is wearing a decorative harness and saddle that covers its back and extends around the torso, chest, and neck. The harness features a combination of red, blue, and beige colors, with curved and angular divisions, and a rolled section forming the saddle. Straps in blue and beige wrap around the dog’s body, connecting the different sections of the harness. The dog also has a red collar around its neck, which matches the color accents on the saddle and harness. The background is plain and unadorned, and the entire composition places the dog centrally within the frame.
title: Carousel Dog
